$description: Shared physics: space, field, measure, reference widths and thresholds, targets, focus, strokes, radius, elevation, island bounds. Identical in every world; plate-edge geometry belongs to each world (world.geometry.plate-edge).

space.$description: 4px rhythm. Values express relationships (a label to its field, a source to its measure), not a uniform margin.

fluid.$description: Fluid pairs a space role clamps between across layout.fluid; label spacing stays fixed.

field-max.$description: Maximum content field. The field is fluid below it.

margin-min.$description: Outer page margin at the narrowest widths.

margin-max.$description: Outer page margin ceiling; between min and max the margin scales with the viewport (about 4vw).

columns.$description: Column count of the field. Important moments may violate the field deliberately (amplitude permitting).

measure.$description: Reading measure in ch, decoupled from page width (a number: DTCG dimensions allow only px/rem; CSS output appends the unit).

reading-measure.$description: Article prose and its responsive column, matching 62 zero advances of Instrument Sans while keeping the width stable as the reading font loads.

shell-width.$description: Width of the one shared command/tenant shell (narrower tenants may reduce it).

dock.$description: Working width of an application dock beside its stage.

dock-dense.$description: Dense application dock width, shared with the command shell; use the working dock width when it cannot fit beside the stage.

stage-min.$description: Minimum application stage width beside a dock before the dock falls back to its working width.

preview-width.$description: Maximum width of a bounded hover/focus reference preview; never reflows prose.

fluid.$description: Viewport range over which fluid space and type interpolate.

from.$description: Viewport width at which fluid values sit at their min.

to.$description: Viewport width at which fluid values reach their max.

breakpoint.$description: Viewport thresholds for @media, through the literal layout partial.

compact.$description: Below it the page takes its single-column composition, and a placed region resolves as mobile whatever the input; from it, a coarse pointer or no hover resolves mobile and a fine pointer with hover resolves web.

wide.$description: From it the full field with its violations and side rail.

navigation.$description: Width at which navigation and narrow component arrangements recompose.

columns.$description: Width at which paired content regions can use multiple columns.

reading.$description: Width required for full reading rails and wide component arrangements.

container.$description: Container inline-size thresholds for @container, through the literal layout partial.

narrow.$description: Below it a component takes its stacked arrangement.

rail.$description: Side-rail wrap: below it the rail moves beneath the main column.

track-min.$description: Minimum auto-fit grid track, used as min(100%, this).

sticky-chrome.$description: Block size of sticky chrome, reserved as the root's scroll padding.

intrinsic-block.$description: contain-intrinsic-size estimate for a content-visibility: auto section.

test-width.$description: Reference widths every page is verified at. Test widths, not layout breakpoints; the same implementation recomposes between them.

phone-small.$description: Reflow stress case; no horizontal scroll.

quote-step.$description: Distance between testimony cards as a fraction of card width.

quote-tilt.$description: Neighbouring testimony card angle around the focused account.

quote-neighbour-scale.$description: Neighbouring testimony card scale relative to the focused account.

min-height.$description: Minimum field height retaining the figure and foreground controls on a wide character entrance.

copy-measure.$description: Short introduction measure beside a character in a continuous field, stable while the reading font loads.

headline-scale.$description: Scale of the display step at the single peak of a character encounter.

min-height.$description: Minimum supporting choice height; complete copy may grow the card.

radius.$description: Rounded edge of a translucent encounter choice.

peek-size.$description: Decorative figure size within a supporting encounter choice.

peek-overhang.$description: Figure recession past the trailing card edge.

peek-bottom.$description: Figure inset above the bottom of its supporting card.

copy-reserve.$description: Trailing territory kept clear of supporting choice copy for the figure.

width.$description: Readable width of an image-bearing supporting choice within a horizontal encounter strip.

headline-min.$description: Smallest paired statement in a cinematic field.

headline-max.$description: Largest paired statement in a cinematic field.

headline-fluid.$description: Viewport width fraction governing a cinematic statement.

premise-width.$description: Short premise measure opposite the paired cinematic statement.

card-width.$description: Width of a chamber invitation within the cinematic field.

card-first-top.$description: Viewport height fraction placing the first chamber invitation.

card-second-top.$description: Viewport height fraction placing the second chamber invitation.

phone-card-top.$description: Handheld viewport height fraction starting the chamber invitations.

phone-card-step.$description: Vertical separation between the two handheld chamber invitations.

card-radius.$description: Soft corner joining a chamber invitation to its optical field.

card-inset.$description: Side and lower inset of an optical scene invitation.

card-inset-start.$description: Upper inset of an optical scene invitation.

pointer-ring.$description: Diameter of the optical pointer ring.

pointer-dot.$description: Diameter of its resting central point.

action-inset-inline.$description: Horizontal space inside the primary scene advance.

action-inset-block.$description: Vertical space inside the primary scene advance.

action-gap.$description: Separation of a primary scene advance from its premise.

pad-min.$description: Handheld edge of the optical field composition.

pad-max.$description: Wide edge of the optical field composition.

pad-fluid.$description: Viewport fraction setting field composition edges.

top-min.$description: Protected opening beneath the field navigation.

top-max.$description: Largest protected opening beneath field navigation.

top-fluid.$description: Viewport height fraction protecting field navigation.

bottom-fluid.$description: Viewport height fraction placing the field baseline.

note-width.$description: Annotation column opposite the field statement.

centre-note-width.$description: Annotation measure under a centred field statement.

column-gap-min.$description: Minimum separation between field statement and annotation.

column-gap-max.$description: Maximum separation between field statement and annotation.

column-gap-fluid.$description: Viewport fraction separating field statement and annotation.

close-width.$description: Measure protecting the final field question.

close-height.$description: Shared optical space occupied by crossfading closing sentences.

line-bleed.$description: Em allowance protecting field headline descenders inside reveal masks.

gutter.$description: Shared editorial opening, header and continuation edge.

caption-width.$description: Programme caption measure within the opening register.

detail-width.$description: Compact explanatory column over an ambient film.

header-clearance.$description: Minimum clear field beneath navigation before the opening copy.

aspect.$description: Minimum wide composition ratio of joined directory choices and their image.

compact-aspect.$description: Minimum image panel ratio below stacked directory choices.

compact-width.$description: Container width below which directory choices precede their image.

tab-share.$description: Fraction of a wide directory preview reserved for its choices.

tab-top.$description: Top inset of the choices as a fraction of their column width.

frame.$description: Continuous surface around a selected directory image.

tab-block.$description: Block padding of a directory preview choice.

tab-start.$description: Leading inset of a directory preview choice.

tab-end.$description: Trailing inset of a directory preview choice.

join-softness.$description: Antialias band of the concave directory choice join.

height.$description: Resting rail height as a fraction of its width; complete captions can increase it.

sliver.$description: Visible share of a resting directory neighbour.

gap.$description: Space between directory cards as a share of the rail.

padding.$description: Inset of captions and ordinal marks as a share of the rail.

corner.$description: Directory clip radius as a share of the rail.

mark.$description: Ordinal mark width as a share of the rail.

caption-gap.$description: Space between premise and title relative to the caption inset.

scroll-below.$description: Width below which a research comparison keeps the width its notation needs and scrolls locally instead of squeezing its equal columns.

drop.$description: Step descent as a fraction of measured path width.

dot-inset.$description: Wide dot offset from its step as a fraction of path width.

dot-raise.$description: Wide dot rise above its step as a fraction of path width.

curve.$description: Early crest height relative to each horizontal hop.

crest-end.$description: Second handle rise relative to the first.

stack-swing.$description: Stacked S-bend reach in dot diameters.

stack-handle.$description: Stacked curve handle fraction of each vertical interval.

stack-below.$description: Width below which process stages form a vertical reading path.

dot-size.$description: Process anchor dot diameter, independent of field width.

dash.$description: Process line dash length, independent of field width.

gap.$description: Process line gap, independent of field width.

pad-top.$description: Wide process top breathing room relative to field width.

pad-side.$description: Wide process inline inset relative to field width.

pad-bottom.$description: Wide process closing room relative to field width.

column-gap.$description: Wide process column gap relative to field width.

stage-min.$description: Minimum static process stage measure before wrapping.

stack-indent.$description: Stacked copy offset from its line.

list-share.$description: Process step list width as a share of the paired list and media field.

media-ratio.$description: Process illustration height relative to its width.

stack-below.$description: Width below which a process illustration follows its selected step.

pad-inline.$description: Focus frame inline inset in heading ems.

pad-block.$description: Focus frame block inset in heading ems.

gap.$description: Separation between focused heading words in heading ems.

arm.$description: Focus corner length in heading ems.

stroke-scale.$description: Focus corner stroke relative to heading size.

quote-card-share.$description: Card width as a share of the deck on a wide surface.

quote-card-ratio.$description: Minimum card height relative to its width; complete accounts may grow taller.

quote-drop.$description: Card descent per step, measured in card widths.

quote-falloff.$description: Additional scale retained by each step beyond the nearest neighbour.

quote-visible-distance.$description: Farthest visible position in the fanned deck.

quote-card-padding.$description: Card padding relative to its width.

quote-card-gap.$description: Card content separation relative to its width.

quote-card-radius.$description: Card corner radius relative to its width.

quote-copy-scale.$description: Quotation type size relative to card width, above the reading floor.

quote-release-threshold.$description: Fraction of a card step needed to commit a drag.

quote-drag-threshold.$description: Minimum horizontal movement before a deck drag begins.

quote-compact-width.$description: Deck width below which the focused account receives a readable handheld measure.

quote-control-icon.$description: Direction mark within a deck navigation control.

quote-choice-mark.$description: Resting choice mark inside its full interaction target.

quote-choice-active.$description: Expanded mark identifying the selected account.

media-aspect.$description: Reserved product overview illustration; authored media keeps its intrinsic ratio.

walkthrough-aspect.$description: Screen-shaped field for an authored product walkthrough reservation.

walkthrough-max.$description: Bounded screen-recording field, centred beneath the product demonstration.

aspect.$description: Minimum width-to-height proportion of a collection folder; complete text may extend it.

tab.$description: Fraction of the folder width occupied by the raised tab.

notch.$description: Depth of the folder step as a fraction of its width.

closed.$description: Resting reveal of collection artwork as a fraction of folder height.

open.$description: Maximum artwork reveal on an opened collection folder, constrained by its complete copy.

peek.$description: Minimum artwork height in width units before complete folder copy.

max-width.$description: Maximum measure of a single collection folder.

viewport-share.$description: Preferred maximum folder height as a share of the viewport; complete copy may grow beyond it.

spacing.$description: Angular separation between adjacent catalogue cards.

radius.$description: Arc radius as a share of the catalogue field width.

lift.$description: Focused catalogue card lift as a share of the field width.

active-scale.$description: Scale of the focused catalogue card.

neighbour-scale.$description: Scale of neighbouring catalogue cards around the focused card.

neighbour-opacity.$description: Opacity of visible neighbouring catalogue cards.

reach.$description: Maximum adjacent catalogue positions shown on either side of the focused card.

card-share.$description: Preferred catalogue card width as a share of a wide field.

compact-card-share.$description: Preferred catalogue card width as a share of a compact field.

viewport-share.$description: Maximum viewport height share reserved for the focused catalogue card.

folder-closed.$description: Resting artwork reveal for title-only catalogue folders as a share of their height.

folder-open.$description: Maximum artwork reveal for title-only catalogue folders, constrained by the complete title.

edge-fade.$description: Distance over which the catalogue arc yields softly at its lower edge.

edge-angle.$description: Maximum angular extent of the visible catalogue fan from its centred card.

quote-company-scale.$description: Company label size relative to the testimony card width, above the metadata floor.

quote-rating-scale.$description: Rating mark size relative to the testimony card width.

quote-avatar-scale.$description: Portrait diameter relative to the testimony card width.

quote-person-scale.$description: Attribution size relative to the testimony card width, above the metadata floor.

quote-person-gap.$description: Gap between the portrait and attribution relative to the testimony card width.

quote-person-inset.$description: Space above the attribution relative to the testimony card width.

card-width.$description: Maximum measure of the selected search result in the depth strip.

compact-card-share.$description: Selected search result width as a share of a compact viewport.

frame-min.$description: Minimum depth-strip height before complete selected result copy expands it.

perspective.$description: Perspective distance of the shared search result depth strip.

step.$description: Horizontal step between depth-strip seats in selected card widths.

retreat.$description: Depth retreat of a result per seat from the selected card, in card widths.

yaw.$description: Angle of each successive search result away from the viewer.

yaw-max.$description: Maximum turn of a peripheral search result.

scale-falloff.$description: Scale reduction per seat from the selected search result.

frame-max.$description: Maximum height of the search discovery field before its result strip.

viewport-share.$description: Search query and refinement region height as a share of the visible viewport, reserving space for the result strip.

center-width.$description: Maximum width of the central search form inside the discovery field.

pond-cell.$description: Character cell pitch of the search discovery pond.

tab.$description: Left-hand cutout as a share of card width, leaving the raised area on the right.

tail.$description: Inline position of the benefit card lower bite, as a share of card width.

top-notch.$description: Benefit card tab rise as a share of card width.

bottom-notch.$description: Benefit card lower bite depth as a share of card width.

radius.$description: Benefit card rounded mask corners as a share of card width.

cell.$description: Character cell pitch of the computational portrait.

reveal-radius.$description: Radius of the pointer aperture revealing registered portrait layers.

preload.$description: Viewport-height margin for bounded preparation before an authored scroll scene enters.

gutter.$description: Inline viewport fraction framing the authored scroll composition.

interval-height.$description: Viewport-height share of a quiet interval.

interval-padding.$description: Vertical viewport share around the paired interval lines.

gallery-before.$description: Viewport-height space before the alternating art studies.

gallery-after.$description: Viewport-height space following the alternating art studies.

gallery-heading-gap.$description: Viewport-height separation below the gallery heading.

gallery-row-gap.$description: Viewport-height separation between the two art studies.

gallery-first-offset.$description: Lower caption placement beside the first art study.

gallery-second-offset.$description: Upper caption placement beside the second art study.

encounter-width.$description: Maximum width of the lower side caption.

encounter-bottom.$description: Viewport-height clearance beneath the side caption.

closing-padding.$description: Vertical viewport space around the closing invitation.

cue-bottom.$description: Viewport clearance below the scroll cue.

gallery-gap.$description: Gap between each image and its caption.

margin-inset.$description: Viewport-width inset of the quiet left margin.

aside-inset.$description: Viewport-width inset of the right marginal line.

aside-top.$description: Vertical placement of the right marginal line.

seal-top.$description: Vertical placement of the late scene signature.

project.$description: Project standard for every actionable control, in its smaller dimension.

compact.$description: Compact application rows and controls with a fine pointer. Coarse pointers and publication controls keep target.project.

width.$description: Focus ring stroke; the ring sits outside the shape.

underline-active.$description: Link and crossing underline on hover/focus.

lit-edge.$description: The one lit edge of a plate.

preview-edge.$description: Target-signature edge on a reference preview.

radius.$description: Corners by component role; functional controls share the optical contour.

preview-join.$description: Concave join between a directory choice and its illustrated preview.

preview-frame.$description: Outer corner of a joined illustrated directory preview.

shell.$description: Shell and preview lift over an untouched page: a far cast and a contact cast.

opacity.$description: Opacity of color.shadow in the far cast.

contact.$description: The contact cast under the shell's edge.

opacity.$description: Opacity of color.shadow in the contact cast.

elevation.$description: Lift of a surface over its ground: every step is cast in color.shadow at its opacity times color.lift.shadow.

plate.$description: A plate or module lifted one step off its ground.

opacity.$description: Opacity of color.shadow in the cast.

popover.$description: A menu or popover anchored to its trigger.

opacity.$description: Opacity of color.shadow in the cast.

offset-y.$description: Cast beneath a translucent scene invitation.

blur.$description: Diffuse underside cast of an optical scene invitation.

spread.$description: Recession of the optical invitation cast.

opacity.$description: Shadow strength beneath an optical invitation.

highlight.$description: Light caught at the upper inside edge of an optical invitation.

opacity.$description: World-shadow strength in the resting bookmark cast.

held-opacity.$description: World-shadow strength in the held bookmark cast.

quote.$description: Soft cast separating overlapping attributed sheets.

opacity.$description: World shadow strength beneath a fan card.

pixel-ratio-max.$description: Cap on the device-pixel ratio an island's drawing buffer is sized by.

start-margin.$description: IntersectionObserver root margin at which an island starts work.
